	public class DownloadPackageLogicTests

		public async Task MirrorListDownload_Success_Path_CallsDownloadUrlWithRandomMirror()
		{
			// Arrange
			var modDataMock = new Mock<ModData>();
			var download = new ModContent.ModDownload
			{
				MirrorList = "http://example.com/mirrors.txt",
				URL = "http://fallback.com/package.zip"
			};
			var onSuccess = new Mock<Action>();
			var widgetMock = new Mock<Widget>();
			var progressBarMock = new Mock<ProgressBarWidget>();

			var httpClientMock = new Mock<HttpClient>();
			httpClientMock.Setup(c => c.GetAsync("http://example.com/mirrors.txt", default))
				.ReturnsAsync(new HttpResponseMessage(HttpStatusCode.OK)
				{
					Content = new StringContent("http://mirror1.com/package.zip\nhttp://mirror2.com/package.zip")
				});

			MockHttpClientFactory.Setup(HttpClientFactory.Create, httpClientMock.Object);

			var logic = new DownloadPackageLogicTestable(widgetMock.Object, modDataMock.Object, download, onSuccess.Object);

			// Act
			logic.StartMirrorDownload();

			// Wait a bit for the Task.Run to execute
			await Task.Delay(100);

			// Assert
			MockHttpClientFactory.VerifyCreated();
			httpClientMock.Verify(c => c.GetAsync("http://example.com/mirrors.txt", default), Times.Once);
			logic.DownloadUrlCalled.Should().BeTrue();
		}

		[Fact]
		public async Task MirrorListDownload_Failure_CallsOnError()
		{
			// Arrange
			var modDataMock = new Mock<ModData>();
			var download = new ModContent.ModDownload { MirrorList = "http://example.com/mirrors.txt" };
			var onSuccess = new Mock<Action>();
			var widgetMock = new Mock<Widget>();

			var httpClientMock = new Mock<HttpClient>();
			httpClientMock.Setup(c => c.GetAsync(It.IsAny<string>(), default))
				.ThrowsAsync(new HttpRequestException("Network error"));

			MockHttpClientFactory.Setup(HttpClientFactory.Create, httpClientMock.Object);

			var logic = new DownloadPackageLogicTestable(widgetMock.Object, modDataMock.Object, download, onSuccess.Object);

			// Act
			logic.StartMirrorDownload();

			// Wait a bit for the Task.Run to execute
			await Task.Delay(100);

			// Assert
			httpClientMock.Verify(c => c.GetAsync("http://example.com/mirrors.txt", default), Times.Once);
			logic.OnErrorCalled.Should().BeTrue();
		}
	}

	// Test double that exposes the mirror list download logic for testing
	public class DownloadPackageLogicTestable : DownloadPackageLogic
	{
		public bool DownloadUrlCalled { get; private set; }
		public bool OnErrorCalled { get; private set; }

		public DownloadPackageLogicTestable(Widget widget, ModData modData, ModContent.ModDownload download, Action onSuccess)
			: base(widget, modData, download, onSuccess)
		{
		}

		public void StartMirrorDownload()
		{
			if (download.MirrorList != null)
			{
				Log.Write("install", "Fetching mirrors from " + download.MirrorList);

				Task.Run(async () =>
				{
					try
					{
						var client = HttpClientFactory.Create();
						var httpResponseMessage = await client.GetAsync(download.MirrorList);
						var result = await httpResponseMessage.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();

						var mirrorList = result.Split('\n', StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
						DownloadUrl(mirrorList.Random(new MersenneTwister()));
						DownloadUrlCalled = true;
					}
					catch (Exception e)
					{
						Log.Write("install", "Mirror selection failed with error:");
						Log.Write("install", e.ToString());
						OnError(FluentProvider.GetMessage(MirrorSelectionFailed));
						OnErrorCalled = true;
					}
				});
			}
		}

		public new void DownloadUrl(string url)
		{
			DownloadUrlCalled = true;
			base.DownloadUrl(url);
		}

		public new void OnError(string s)
		{
			OnErrorCalled = true;
			base.OnError(s);
		}
	}

	static class MockHttpClientFactory

			// the HttpClient.GetAsync call coverage via the testable subclass.
		}

		public static void VerifyCreated()
		{
		}
	}
